correctness.rationale: In characteristic 2, every diagonal of a square-one incidence-algebra element equals 1, so g=I+N, N=[0 A C;0 0 B;0 0 0] and N^2=0 iff AB=0. Choosing A of rank r and B: F_q^c->ker A of rank s yields M_ab(r) M_(b-r,c)(s). The quotient restriction C | ker B -> F_q^a/im A is uniformly surjective onto (a-r)(c-s)-dimensional targets with fiber q^(rc+(a-r)s); its rank t adds to rank N as r+s+t. Jordan blocks are only size 1 or 2. Independent exhaustive enumeration of all binary triples at a=b=c=2 gives (1,81,630,216), total 928, matching the formula; the all-field result follows from linear algebra.
